mechanism: One QK B-fragment LDSM.x4 replaces two adjacent x2, with upper-lane addresses corrected; same source MMA order.

cpu_symbolic_fragment_proof.quantification: all byte values; each byte represented by its unique source coordinate
cpu_symbolic_fragment_proof.mma_order: grp then nt then kk=0,1; same A and C registers and exact B bytes
cpu_symbolic_fragment_proof.fp32_order: unchanged donor suffix after both IMMA calls in each group
cpu_symbolic_fragment_proof.proof_limit: PTX data movement and source order; no CUDA compiler or GPU execution

decision: Reject before host harness/GPU. Baseline already spills; candidate adds 16B stack and 16B spill stores/loads. Fewer fragment-load instructions do not justify this resource regression. Revisit only with a new ownership/liveness mechanism that removes pressure.
